description: Mozart Dice Piano Tutor v1 - A systems-based musical training environment using Mozart's dice game principles to teach harmonic literacy, pattern recognition, and motor control

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js project with TypeScript and Tailwind
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a working Next.js project scaffold so that all subsequent stories have a foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js app created with TypeScript, App Router, and Tailwind CSS
Project builds successfully with `npm run build`
Dev server starts with `npm run dev`
Root page renders a heading: 'Dice & Discipline'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Next.js 16 with TypeScript, Tailwind v4, App Router, src directory

userStories.title: Add core domain types and data model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared TypeScript types for Measure, Pattern, DiceRoll, and Exercise so that all modules use consistent contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /lib/domain/types.ts with Measure, Pattern, DiceRoll, Exercise, and ExpectedNote types
Measure has fields: id, type ('mozart'|'agitato'), rightHandPattern, leftHandPattern, harmonicFunction, difficulty
Pattern has fields: notes (number[]), fingering (number[]), shapeId (string)
DiceRoll has fields: die1 (number), die2 (number), sum (number)
Types are exported and importable from other modules
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Mozart dice lookup tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the historical Mozart minuet and trio lookup tables so the dice engine can map rolls to measure IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /lib/mozart/mozartTables.ts
mozartMinuetTable is a 16x11 array (16 bars, dice sums 2-12 mapped to indices 0-10)
mozartTrioTable is a 16x11 array with the same structure
Tables contain historically accurate Mozart K.516f measure IDs
Index comments explain the bar/sum mapping
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: historically accurate K.516f tables in app/src/lib/mozart/mozartTables.ts

userStories.title: Add Mozart minuet generator with dice rolling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function that takes 16 dice rolls and returns a 16-bar minuet composition by looking up the Mozart tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /lib/mozart/generateMinuet.ts
rollDice() generates a random 2d6 roll returning a DiceRoll object
generateMinuet() accepts optional fixed rolls or generates random ones
Output is an array of 16 measure IDs looked up from mozartMinuetTable
Fixed dice input produces deterministic output
Invalid dice values (outside 1-6) throw descriptive errors
Unit tests cover deterministic output and error cases
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: generateMinuet.ts with rollDice, validateRoll, generateMinuet functions. 9 tests passing.

userStories.title: Add Zustand state store for dice and exercise state
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a global state store to hold the current dice rolls, selected measures, playback state, and tempo.
acceptanceCriteria: Install zustand as a dependency
Create /lib/state/useAppStore.ts with Zustand store
Store holds: currentRolls (DiceRoll[]), measureIds (number[]), selectedBar (number|null), tempo (number), isPlaying (boolean)
Store has actions: rollAllDice, selectBar, setTempo, togglePlayback
rollAllDice generates 16 rolls and computes measureIds from Mozart tables
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: useAppStore.ts with Zustand v5, all state and actions implemented

userStories.title: Add dice rolling UI with animation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a 'Roll Dice' button and see animated dice that resolve to sums, so I can generate a new minuet.
acceptanceCriteria: Roll Dice button is visible on the main page
Clicking it triggers dice animation (brief visual randomization before settling)
After animation, 16 dice sums (one per bar) are displayed
Dice results are stored in the Zustand store
Button can be clicked again to re-roll
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: DiceRoller.tsx with 600ms animation, 8x2 grid display of sums

userStories.title: Add 16-bar measure grid UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a grid of 16 bars showing the selected measure IDs after rolling dice, so I can visualize the generated minuet.
acceptanceCriteria: After rolling dice, a 16-cell grid appears showing bar numbers 1-16
Each cell displays the measure ID selected by the dice for that bar
Clicking a bar cell selects it (visually highlighted)
Selected bar index is stored in the Zustand store
Grid is responsive and readable
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: MeasureGrid.tsx with 8x2 clickable grid, amber highlight on selection

userStories.title: Add visual piano keyboard component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a visual piano keyboard on screen so I can see which notes are active or expected.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /components/Keyboard/PianoKeyboard.tsx and /components/Keyboard/PianoKey.tsx
Keyboard renders MIDI notes 48-84 (3 octaves centered on middle C) by default
White and black keys are visually distinct with proper piano layout
Component accepts activeNotes prop (Set<number>) to highlight pressed keys in blue
Component accepts expectedNotes prop (number[]) to highlight target keys in green
Keys show note names (C, D, E, etc.) on white keys
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: PianoKeyboard.tsx + PianoKey.tsx, MIDI 48-84, blue active / green expected highlighting

userStories.title: Add placeholder measure data with note patterns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need sample musical data for a subset of Mozart measure IDs so the app can display notes on the keyboard and play them back.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /lib/mozart/measureData.ts
Define at least 12 sample measures with right-hand and left-hand note patterns
Each measure has an array of ExpectedNote objects with midi note numbers, startMs, and endMs
Each measure has a harmonicFunction label (e.g., 'I', 'V', 'IV')
Each measure has a brief teachingText explanation
Data is keyed by measure ID matching entries in mozartMinuetTable
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: measureData.ts with 12 sample measures including note patterns, harmonic functions, teaching text

userStories.title: Add tempo control slider
userStories.description: As a user, I want a tempo slider so I can control the playback speed of the selected measure.
acceptanceCriteria: Tempo slider is visible below the piano keyboard
Slider range is 40-120 BPM with default at 60 BPM
Current BPM value is displayed next to the slider
Changing the slider updates the tempo in the Zustand store
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: TempoSlider.tsx with range 40-120 BPM, default 60, connected to store

userStories.title: Add measure playback with looping
userStories.description: As a user, I want to play back a selected measure and see expected notes highlighted on the keyboard in time, with looping support.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a bar and clicking Play highlights expected notes on the keyboard in sequence
Notes highlight at the correct time based on their startMs/endMs scaled to current tempo
Playback loops automatically when it reaches the end of the measure
A Stop button stops playback and resets
Playback uses requestAnimationFrame or setTimeout for timing
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: PlaybackControls.tsx with rAF-based timing, tempo scaling, auto-looping

userStories.title: Add teaching overlay for selected bar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see teaching information when I select a bar, including the hand shape hint, harmonic function, and a short explanation.
acceptanceCriteria: When a bar is selected, a panel appears showing teaching info for that measure
Panel displays: harmonic function label (e.g., 'I - Tonic')
Panel displays: a 1-2 sentence 'Why this works' explanation
Panel displays: fingering numbers for right hand
If no measure data exists for the ID, show 'Data not yet available'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: TeachingPanel.tsx with harmonic function badge, teaching text, fingering, fallback message
